digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / Jira Cloud S3 reconciler
propositions: A new read-only live test suite for Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation over S3 store backend must be added to cover REB and DIG projects at real volume and diversity

The suite must enforce read-only semantics structurally by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, set_entity_property, delete_issue, transition_issue_by_name, unassign_issue, set_parent, update_priority, update_issuetype, update_comment, delete_comment, delete_issue_link) to raise JiraWriteForbidden

Test scenarios must validate: (1) one isolated S3 store maps both REB and DIG; (2) inbound fetch pulls both projects at real volume with per-project attribution; (3) fetch and preview scoped per project with zero cross-contamination; (4) S3 push/clone round-trip preserves the mapping; (5) unknown mapped project key fails closed (raises), never silently succeeds
Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after all Jira-touching scenarios, and bridge_preview must run in DRY_RUN mode with persist=False

The test suite must use a fresh isolated S3 store with only a throwaway git-remote-s3 remote (wired via s3://<bucket>/<unique-prefix> with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off), deleted in teardown, never reaching production

A new manually-dispatched jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal CI job must be added to .github/workflows/external-integration.yml, and the existing external job must ignore the new test directory to prevent double-collection
